statement: WiiBrew revision 120079 documents an inactive MotionPlus A600F7 first-stage progression 0x02,0x04,0x08,0x0c,0x0e and changing A60050-area contents during initialization. Dolphin 2019/2026 emulator register commentary independently records the same stage labels, but does not provide its own raw hardware trace. This is a hardware-derived community-reported observation at moderate confidence, not an owned physical experiment or proof of the same active A400F7 behavior on all external/integrated/TR revisions.
